# Community maps

## bhop_lego

- Map: **Tony Montana (tmontana)**.
- LEGO textures: **Man Walker**.
- Testing and feedback: **Nyastle**.
- Original release: https://gamebanana.com/mods/125406
- Original download: https://gamebanana.com/dl/294484
- Author's license: **Creative Commons Attribution–NonCommercial–NoDerivatives 4.0**, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/
- `bhop_lego.zip` is the author's **unmodified** `bhop_lego_3.zip` archive. Its original MD5 is `c916f2a56ef10e3a0a025c2c07d12e00`.
- The thumbnail is the original release's screenshot: https://images.gamebanana.com/img/ss/mods/sgi_sd_image_51a101a63e50d.webp

The browser reads the original BSP in memory. No edited or converted map is distributed. This map and its art retain the author's license and are not covered by any license for Movement Lab's code. Do not use this bundled map commercially or distribute an edited release without the author's permission.

The compatibility layer supports brush geometry, embedded base textures, convex collision, teleport filters, delayed player-name outputs, push triggers and knife-activated boost buttons. Rendering does not emulate Source lightmaps, studio-model props, water physics, moving brushes, or collectible/bonus scripts. Main-route checkpoints use the map's existing teleport destinations. Local imports remain in memory and are never uploaded.

ZIP decompression uses **fflate 0.8.2** by Arjun Barrett, MIT license. See `vendor/fflate-LICENSE.txt`.
